name: repo-radar
description: A local desktop app that watches all your Git repos and surfaces the few that need you — unfinished work, PRs, CI, stashes, stale projects. Local-first, tray-resident, 18 languages.
author: rockbenben <qingwhat@gmail.com>

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,app "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w desktop"
scripts.test: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w desktop && npm test -w server && npm test -w web && npm test -w desktop
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w desktop
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w desktop
